title: List Gmail drafts with AI and find unfinished emails
h1: find the gmail drafts you have left unfinished
description: Have a bot list Gmail drafts with recipients and subjects, spot messages you still need to finish and explain gaps in a paginated result.
answer: a bot can list the drafts in your gmail account and bring an unfinished-email checklist into chat. ask for full details so it sees who each draft is to and what it says. the list has no guaranteed order, and a newly saved draft may take a little time to appear. it can inspect the drafts with read-only access without editing or sending them.
what:
this gives you an inventory of saved emails, useful when a half-written note has slipped out of mind. full details help the bot tell a real follow-up from an abandoned draft.

a long list comes in pages, and gmail doesn't sort it by date, so the bot reads every page before telling you what's there.
uses: find the unfinished email to a grant reviewer without opening every draft
collect draft subjects and recipients before you clear out your own drafts folder
check whether a proposal was saved as a draft after you lost track of the compose window

routine.message: on mondays at 2, list all my gmail drafts with full details and finish every page of results. bring me a checklist here of drafts addressed to people at pebblewake arts, showing recipient, subject and a short note on what remains unfinished. mark missing details as unknown. never edit, delete or send any draft.
routine.needs: gmail connected, read only access for listing draft details
routine.output:
pebblewake arts drafts
- marina: workshop proposal, closing paragraph is unfinished.
- jun: materials list, body refers to an attachment that needs checking.
all returned pages reviewed; no drafts changed.

steps: give your inbox reviewer **read only** gmail access in **Connected apps**.
request full draft details and ask for recipients beside subjects so similar titles stay distinguishable.
try the checklist once before scheduling it, then inspect its schedule card. **Edit** changes the timing and **Pause** stops future reviews.
watch: newly created drafts may be missing briefly. an immediate empty result does not prove a save failed.
a first page is not the entire folder. require the bot to say when unread pages or an error leave the list incomplete.

faq.q: can it list draft bodies as well as subjects?
faq.a: yes. ask for full details and it reads each draft's text, not just the subject.

faq.q: why is the draft i just created missing?
faq.a: new drafts may not appear immediately in this listing. wait before checking again, and avoid rapid repeat calls that can trigger rate limits.
